name: EPIC 246072535
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 10.3 solar radii and 1.10 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246072535 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.33647 (16th-84th percentiles 9.955033-10.804869), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246072535 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.104399 (16th-84th percentiles 1.012876-1.229367), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246072535: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4759.581 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246072535 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3169.179688 (16th-84th percentiles 3073.085938-3276.953125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,169 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.10 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,760 K at its surface.
